lane: Skills governance, reusable project template, Singapore SQL packet v2 evidence
goal: Record the Owner decisions of 2026-11-04; rebuild the Singapore SQL packet as v2 (33 migrations, new seed) with fresh local rehearsals because the 2a-approved hash lapsed, and ask for re-approval; review the repository skills together with the mca capabilities, tighten nilaza-plan-qc, add a nilaza-ai-runtime skill, install skills for Claude Code as well as Codex; and create a portable project-template folder distilled from this project for the Owner to reuse.
successCriteria: PLAN.md lists the 2026-11-04 Owner decisions and the v2 re-approval as the next 2c step.

docs/release/singapore-packet-v2-2026-11-04 holds the 33-file manifest, a PASS PGlite replay (10/10) and a PASS Docker rehearsal (33 migrations, 17/17 checks) and one re-approval request; nothing ran on a cloud project.
scripts/rehearse-nilaza-database.mjs accepts --manifest for a later packet and keeps the old default.
npm run skills:validate passes with nilaza-plan-qc 1.6.0 and the new nilaza-ai-runtime; skills:sync installs to both Codex and Claude Code skill folders.
docs/SKILLS_REVIEW_2026-11-04.vi.md explains keep/change/remove for every skill and how mca capabilities fit.

project-template/ contains a self-contained, project-neutral starter kit (instructions, PLAN, handoff, plan-QC protocol, feature-plan template, approval form, skills) with a README on how to apply it.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL, deploy, secret or setting change on any Supabase project; 2c waits for re-approval of the v2 hash and Owner dashboard reads.
The 2026-10-25 packet folder, release-profile.json and the target draft keep the 2a hash until the Owner re-approves.
No app, Admin or Edge Function code change.

Backend items the Owner approved on 2026-11-04 (auth and quota for daily insight and astrology report, LLM fallback phase 0, nickname for AI, Tarot 1/day, Premium test account) are tracked in PLAN.md for the next slice.
